units.source_text: 夜里，我乱翻抽屉的时候，翻出了一本《构宅安危论》。

en.t: One night, while rummaging through my drawers, I found a copy of On the Safety and Peril of House Construction.

units.source_text: 这是一本风水书。

en.t: It was a book on feng shui.

units.source_text: 是由祖父口述，自乐（邻村的一个男人，是祖父的占卜学和风水学的徒弟）记录下来的。

en.t: My grandfather had dictated it, and Jile, a man from the neighboring village who was his pupil in divination and feng shui, had written it down.

units.source_text: 先前虽努力争取出版，也同丰川（大阪的富豪）谈过，但没有谈成。

en.t: Earlier, we had tried hard to get it published and had even spoken with Toyokawa, a wealthy man from Osaka, but nothing came of it.

units.source_text: 如今这本草稿已被遗忘，扔在我的抽屉里。

en.t: Now the manuscript had been forgotten and left lying in my drawer.

units.source_text: 啊，祖父一生不得志。

en.t: Ah, my grandfather never fulfilled his ambitions in life.

units.source_text: 他干的一切事业全都失败了，

en.t: Everything he undertook ended in failure,

units.source_text: 他心里该怎么想呢？

en.t: so what must he have felt in his heart?

units.source_text: 啊，感谢上天保佑。

en.t: Ah, thanks be to heaven for its protection.

units.source_text: 在这逆境中，他活到了七十五岁。

en.t: Even amid such adversity, he lived to be seventy-five.

units.source_text: 他心脏良好。

en.t: His heart was strong.

units.source_text: （祖父之所以能够忍受悲恸，活得长寿，我认为是他心脏良好的缘故。）

en.t: I believe my grandfather was able to endure grief and live so long because his heart was strong.

units.source_text: 他的几个孩子和孙子都先于他辞世了。

en.t: Several of his children and grandchildren died before he did.

units.source_text: 他没有话伴，看不见也听不到（又失明又耳背），很是孤独。

en.t: He had no one to talk to, could neither see nor hear, being blind and hard of hearing, and was deeply lonely.

units.source_text: 所谓孤独的悲哀，说的就是祖父。

en.t: If there is such a thing as the sorrow of loneliness, it was my grandfather.

units.source_text: 在祖父来说，“哭着过日子”这句口头禅，确是吐露了真情实况。

en.t: For my grandfather, his pet phrase, spending the days in tears, truly expressed the reality of his life.

units.source_text: 据说祖父占八卦，看风水，很是灵验，颇有点名气。

en.t: It was said that my grandfather's hexagram divinations and feng shui readings were remarkably accurate, and that he had acquired some reputation for them.

units.source_text: 也有人是从老远来请他占卜看看的。

en.t: Some people even came from far away to ask him to tell their fortunes.

units.source_text: 我想，倘若出版祖父的《构宅安危论》，人世间的不幸就可能得到解救了吧。

en.t: I thought that if my grandfather's On the Safety and Peril of House Construction were published, perhaps the misfortunes of the world might be relieved.

units.source_text: 记得那时节，我心中对祖父的占卜学或风水学是不怎么相信的。

en.t: I remember that at the time, in my heart, I did not really believe in my grandfather's divination or feng shui.

units.source_text: 确切地说，也不是不相信，是模棱两可。

en.t: To be exact, it was not that I disbelieved; I was simply undecided.

units.source_text: 虽说在农村，我已经是十六岁的中学三年级学生了，

en.t: Even though it was the countryside, I was already a sixteen-year-old third-year middle school student,

units.source_text: 祖父便秘了三十天，竟不请医生来诊治，

en.t: yet when my grandfather had been constipated for thirty days, we still did not call a doctor to examine him,

units.source_text: 还占卜什么狐仙，相信什么“邪魔附体”之类，

en.t: and instead performed divinations about fox spirits and believed in things like possession by evil forces,

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，真是哭笑不得啊！

en.t: thinking back on it now, I truly do not know whether to laugh or cry.
